examples.code:
use stucco::theme::{ButtonDepth, Finish, Fonts, HeaderStyle, HeadingFont,
    HeadingWeight, Motion, NavStyle, PanelStyle, Preset, Radius, ShellLayout, Theme};

let theme = Theme::preset(Preset::Sand)
    .fonts(Fonts::system())
    .heading_font(HeadingFont::Serif)
    .heading_weight(HeadingWeight::Regular)
    .finish(Finish::Sand)
    .header_style(HeaderStyle::Plain)
    .shell_layout(ShellLayout::Topbar)
    .nav_style(NavStyle::Bar)
    .panel_style(PanelStyle::Ruled)
    .radius(Radius::Soft)
    .button_depth(ButtonDepth::Raised)
    .motion(Motion::Gentle);

use stucco::{Bundle, theme::Preset};

let bundle = Bundle::new(Preset::Pine);

use stucco::theme::{Color, Density, Fonts, Radius, Theme, TypeScale};

let theme = Theme::from_seed(160.0) // accent hue in OKLCH degrees
    .accent(Color::oklch(0.6, 0.14, 160.0))
    .neutral_hue(150.0)
    .neutral_tint(0.012)
    .fonts(Fonts::system().sans("Inter"))
    .type_scale(TypeScale::new(16.0, 1.25))
    .radius(Radius::Round)
    .density(Density::Compact);
let built = theme.build()?; // fails with a report if any pair misses its contrast target

use stucco::theme::{Finish, Preset, Theme};

let theme = Theme::preset(Preset::Sand).finish(Finish::Float);
